Name: Improved Tracker
Author: GrendG
Description:
Let's admit it, the Tracker profession is a bit lackluster--it allows you to see the position of foragable items, artifact spots, and panning locations when you are outdoors.  This profession generally pales in comparison to the alternative, the Botanist profession which causes all foraged items to be of Iridium quality.
This mod gives the Tracker profession a little boost to make it better-balanced with the Botanist profession.  With this mod, you will be able to track foragable items anywhere (even in the mines!), seed spots, bubbly spots for fishing, berry bushes, and coconut trees.
